title: Reading a Change as a Reviewer
objective: Make a change on a notes branch, then print the commits it adds to main and the size of the change.
hint: Commit the README on main, git switch -c notes, Add-Content for Review note, git add, git commit -q -m "Add review note". Then Write-Output (git log main..notes --format=%s), and Write-Output (git diff --stat main notes).
